title: Potain launches innovative power solutions for cleaner, quieter, and more efficient lifting
summary: A comprehensive range of power solutions supports Potain top-slewing and self-erecting cranes.Customers can lower energy, fuel, and infrastructure costs while accelerating return on investment.
body_markdown:
## Optimized energy performance for every crane category


For smaller top-slewing tower cranes, there is the Potain PP200 with a flywheel energy storage design that harnesses kinetic energy and releases it during peaks and/or supports existing power sources. This means customers using the Potain PP200 can switch to a cheaper, lower power tariff.


For larger tower cranes, the PP200 supports units with heavy-duty winches that work in conjunction with a generator. In these cases, a smaller generator can be used which means lower on-site fuel consumption and generator costs, along with improved reliability of power. It’s especially useful for cranes doing duty-cycle work such as pouring concrete, where the frequent lifting cycles create high power peaks.


For self-erecting cranes, Manitowoc offers the[PowerBoost™](https://www.manitowoc.com/company/news/potain-launches-powerboost-add-battery-capacity-self-erecting-cranes) , which was announced for sale earlier this year, and is tailored for the Potain Igo M 24-19. This plug-and-play solution works as a standalone power source or in conjunction with on-site power. A key advantage is the ability to assemble and operate the Igo M 24-19 immediately upon arrival, even before permanent grid power is available. This enables work to begin sooner and reduces potential project delays.


Completing the portfolio is Mobiload, a compact, mobile electric charging solution designed to deliver power wherever it is needed on the jobsite. The compact unit measures less than 1 m3 for easy transport and deployment and can be commissioned in 10 minutes for fast installation. Units can be purchased or rented directly from Manitowoc.


“With Potain’s power solutions customers can ensure a fast return on investment through reduced infrastructure and energy costs. Good quality, consistent energy supply is an increasingly important element of crane ownership, and this new range of Potain solutions is an important milestone in our evolution of aftermarket products,” said Jérôme Chanel, VP Aftermarket.
